source_of_truth: Read by hand in src/components/DocViewer.tsx, a 'use client' component rendered by the initial src/app/page.tsx. Four independent defects coexist: line 2 `import * as pdfjsLib from 'pdfjs-dist'` is a static value import of a heavy PDF runtime (bundle signal, heuristic); line 12 `<ThemeCtx.Provider value={{ theme, user }}>` passes a fresh object literal as the context value on every render, so every consumer re-renders (heuristic, no React Compiler is configured); line 14 `key={i}` keys a list by the array index (heuristic: safe for a static list, wrong on reorder/insert/delete); line 17 `key={Date.now()}` is a fresh value every render, remounting every row (confirmed). Each line was read individually; the levels follow the evidence contract (confirmed = certain syntactic fact, heuristic = plausible risk to measure), not the tool.

expected.rationale: static value import of pdfjs-dist, a heavy document runtime, in a client-reachable component; reaches the startup bundle.

the Provider value is a fresh { theme, user } object literal each render; its identity changes every render, re-rendering all consumers. No React Compiler dependency or config is present, so heuristic (a fix-by-hand risk), not info.

list keyed by the array index: correct only for a never-reordering list; a reorder/insert/delete reuses the wrong DOM/state. Heuristic because static analysis cannot know whether this list changes shape.
key={Date.now()} is a fresh value on every render, forcing every item to remount; a certain syntactic fact (confirmed).
